title: Colossians Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Colossians 2: treasures of wisdom hidden in Christ, the handwriting nailed to the cross, and warnings about ordinances of men.

questions.text: For which city, besides them, does he say he struggles greatly?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 says he wants them to know how greatly he struggles for them, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen his face in the flesh.

answers.text: Laodicea
Hierapolis
Thessalonica
Philippi

questions.text: What does verse 3 say is hidden in him?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that in him all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

answers.text: The mystery kept for the last day
The record of their trespasses
All the treasures of wisdom and knowledge
The inheritance of the saints in light

questions.text: Having received Christ Jesus the Lord, how are they to walk?
questions.explanation: Verses 6 and 7 say that as they received Christ Jesus the Lord, they are to walk in him, rooted and built up in him, established in the faith as they were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

answers.text: In the ordinances that were handed down to them
In him, rooted and built up in him and established in the faith
In the fear of the rulers and powers of this age
In the light they had before they believed

questions.text: Through what does verse 8 warn that someone may rob them?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 warns them not to let anyone rob them through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

answers.text: Threats and open violence from the rulers
Signs and wonders done among them in secret
Letters written to them in another name
Philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men

questions.text: What does verse 9 say dwells bodily in him?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says that in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily.

answers.text: All the fullness of the Deity
The hope of glory
The word of the truth
The Spirit of promise

questions.text: According to verse 12, how were they buried with him, and how were they raised?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says they were buried with him in baptism, in which they were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

answers.text: Buried in his death, and raised by keeping his commandments
Buried with him in baptism, and raised through faith in the working of God
Buried with the fathers, and raised at the last trumpet
Buried in the body of his flesh, and raised in the Spirit of holiness

questions.text: What does verse 14 say he did with the handwriting in ordinances that was against us?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says he wiped out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us, took it out of the way, and nailed it to the cross.

answers.text: He gave it to the angels to keep
He hid it until the day of redemption
He wrote it again on their hearts
He wiped it out and nailed it to the cross

questions.text: In what does verse 16 say no one should judge them?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says to let no one judge them in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day.

answers.text: Marriage, work or travel from city to city
Speech, dress or the use of their wealth
Eating, drinking, a feast day, a new moon or a Sabbath day
Prayer, fasting or the giving of alms

questions.text: By what does verse 18 say someone might rob them of their prize?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says to let no one rob them of their prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in things he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind.

answers.text: Self-abasement and worshiping of the angels
Boasting in the law and in circumcision
Slander spoken against the apostles
Signs demanded from heaven

questions.text: Which words does verse 21 quote as the ordinances they are subjected to?
questions.explanation: Verse 21 quotes the ordinances as "Don't handle, nor taste, nor touch", and verse 22 says all of these perish with use.

answers.text: "Don't look, nor listen, nor speak"
"Don't buy, nor sell, nor lend"
"Don't eat, nor drink, nor rest"
"Don't handle, nor taste, nor touch"
